discovery_metadata.tier2_method: Playwright (firefox engine, --scroll, --timeout 180000) via scripts/fetch_rates_playwright.js — JS-rendered page; NRE page serves the same combined Domestic/NRO/NRE rate card.

rate_slabs.tenure_text: 3 years and above but less than 4 years
4 years and above but less than 5 years
5 years and above upto and inclusive of 10 years

warnings: Kotak serves a single combined 'Domestic / NRO / NRE' rate card; NRE rates equal the domestic general rates ('Less than Rs.3 Crore' Regular column).

NRE fixed deposits have a regulatory minimum tenure of 1 year (365 days), so only slabs from '365 Days to less than 15 Months' onward are included. Senior-citizen premium does not apply to NRE (non-resident) deposits, so rate_senior_pct is null for all slabs.
Rs.3-5 Cr and bulk tiers excluded per task scope (below_3cr retail only).
